buttons.onClick: {()=>{if(action.type==='Uitvoering bevestigen'&&(!Number.isFinite(Number(minutes))||Number(minutes)<0)){toast.error('Vul geldige minuten in.');return}if(['Urencontrole','Niet verschenen'].includes(action.type)&&!reason.trim()){toast.error('Voeg een toelichting toe.');return}change(action.type+' vastgelegd',d=>{const b=d.bookings.find(b=>b.id===action.b.id)!;b.reason=reason;if(action.type==='Overname aanbieden')b.swap=true;else if(action.type==='Uitvoering bevestigen'){b.status='Aanwezig';b.minutes=Number(minutes);d.requests.filter(r=>r.type==='Urencontrole'&&r.hh===b.hh).forEach(r=>r.status='Afgehandeld');d.households.find(h=>h.id===b.hh)!.blocked=false}else if(action.type==='Niet verschenen')b.status='Niet verschenen';else if(action.type==='Ziekmelding')b.status='Ziek gemeld';else if(action.type==='Urencontrole'){b.status='In beoordeling';d.households.find(h=>h.id===b.hh)!.blocked=true;d.requests.push({id:uid('r'),hh:b.hh,person:b.personId,type:'Urencontrole',reason,status:'In behandeling',reviews:[]})}else{const t=d.shifts.find(t=>t.id===b.shiftId)!;const days=(new Date(t.date).getTime()-new Date(TODAY).getTime())/864e5;b.status=days<b.cancelDays?'Laat afgemeld':'Afgemeld'}d.notifications.unshift({id:uid('n'),title:action.type,text:nameOf(d,b.personId),route:'diensten',read:false,kind:'Verenigingstaak'})});setAction(null)}}

buttons.onClick: {()=>{const t=s.shifts.find(t=>t.id===selected.shiftId)!,p=s.people.find(p=>p.id===executor)!;if(selected.personId===executor){toast.error('Je kunt je eigen verenigingstaak niet overnemen.');return}const err=bookingError(s,t,p,swapWith||undefined);if(err){toast.error(err);return}const other=s.bookings.find(b=>b.id===swapWith);if(other){const err2=bookingError(s,s.shifts.find(t=>t.id===other.shiftId)!,s.people.find(p=>p.id===selected.personId)!,selected.id);if(err2){toast.error('Ruilpartner: '+err2);return}}change(other?'Beide verenigingstaken zijn geruild':'Verenigingstaak definitief overgenomen',d=>{const b=d.bookings.find(b=>b.id===selected.id)!;const oldPerson=b.personId,oldHh=b.hh;b.personId=executor;b.hh=p.hh;b.swap=false;if(other){const ob=d.bookings.find(b=>b.id===other.id)!;ob.personId=oldPerson;ob.hh=oldHh;ob.swap=false}d.notifications.unshift({id:uid('n'),title:'Dienstoverdracht bevestigd',text:t.title,route:'diensten',read:false,kind:'Verenigingstaak'})});setSelected(null)}}
